Jae K.: Planning maintenance Sun 02:00-04:00 UTC for AZ-east1 NIC microcode + staggered GPU node reboots.
Priya R.: Scope?
Jae K.: 4 racks (r-ae-241..244). Expect ~12% capacity loss in AZ-east1. Hosted API should route away; Dedicated customers may be affected if pinned to those racks.
Nate S.: Canary rack r-ae-241 for 30m. Rollback if 95p latency increases >50ms or error rate spikes.
ops-bot: Created maintenance MW-2026-az-east1-nic-1976543211 (1976543211 -> 1976546811).
Priya R.: Ops runbook: cordon + drain per rack -> wait-for-empty (20m) -> apply microcode -> reboot -> 10m warm-up between racks. Keep drains staggered to avoid KV cache cold start.
SRE Oncall: Alerts to add: pod restarts >3/min; tail latency >200ms sustained 10m. I'll wire PagerDuty and the alert runbook.
Nate S.: Reserve 3 standby GPUs in AZ-east1 to absorb traffic and reduce cross-region egress. Cost note: if 4% of traffic fails over for 2.5h -> ~0.8TB extra egress (~$60). Tag cost center INF-MW-421.
Jae K.: Maria C. (cc) will post status page copy and internal triage channel. I'll upload node IDs and tenant list to the infra ticket.
Priya R.: Support playbook snippet: if customers see latency, check routing -> confirm fallback region AZ-west2; verify tenant pinning; escalate if errors >1%.
Jae K.: TL;DR: Sun 02:00-04:00 UTC, AZ-east1 NIC microcode + staggered GPU reboots, canary r-ae-241, standby GPUs reserved, rollback thresholds set. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
